en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a waterfront street lined with long wooden buildings in a Nordic/European architectural style. In the background rises a tall, slender church spire with a clock or decorative panels near the top. A stone embankment with a small stairway runs along the front, and a few people are visible walking along the road. The word "Kotka" is printed in the upper left corner.
